project_milestones.title: Problem Ground Validation & Electrical Grid Profiling in Kanke
project_milestones.description: Logged 48-hour continuous voltage waveforms across 4 transformer tapings in Arsande village. Identified brownouts dropping to 138V AC during 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM pumping hours.
project_milestones.mentor_feedback: Thorough ground measurement. Voltage sags align precisely with citizen complaint data.

project_milestones.title: VFD & Hybrid Solar Boost Circuit Design Specification
project_milestones.description: Completed circuit simulation of buck-boost power conditioning stage with MPPT algorithm capable of accepting combined 2kW Solar DC + erratic 140V-260V AC grid line.
project_milestones.mentor_feedback: Excellent dual-source blending logic. Approved for bench breadboarding.

project_milestones.title: Hardware Prototype Assembly & Enclosure Fabrication
project_milestones.description: Assembled ruggedized IP65 weather-proof controller prototype with thermal heat sink, IGBT inverter bridge, and GSM telemetry module.
project_milestones.mentor_feedback: Thermal margins look solid under 100% inductive load test.

project_milestones.title: Laboratory Rig Testing under Brownout Grid Conditions
project_milestones.description: Conducted 72-hour continuous dynamometer endurance testing at BIT Mesra Electrical Machine Lab under fluctuating voltage (130V to 270V). Zero pump trip events recorded.
project_milestones.mentor_feedback: Passed rigorous lab validation. Certified for rural community deployment.

project_milestones.title: Community Field Pilot Installation in Kanke Village
project_milestones.description: Installed 3 pilot units connected to communal 5HP irrigation pumps in Arsande and Sukurhutu. 42 farmer families currently drawing uninterrupted irrigation water.
project_milestones.mentor_feedback: Community feedback is outstanding. Farmers report 100% water availability for vegetable crops.

project_milestones.title: Long-term Field Validation & Energy Savings Audit
project_milestones.description: Evaluate 90-day continuous field deployment, measuring pump life extension and farmer diesel expenditure reductions.
project_milestones.mentor_feedback: Verified and approved by Lead Faculty Mentor.
